identifiedPrevalence.counted: children receiving tsukyu resource-room instruction for gengo shogai (speech and language disorder)
identifiedPrevalence.note: Children in national, public and private primary, lower and upper secondary schools receiving tsukyu ni yoru shido (resource-room instruction) for the disability type gengo shogai, 2023; MEXT, Reiwa 5 nendo Tsukyu ni yoru shido jisshi jokyo chosa, table (1). gengo shogai is the largest single category of the 203,376 children receiving such instruction. A count of children the school system has placed in the category, not an epidemiological estimate; the category covers speech as well as language.

identifiedPrevalence.counted: public primary school children receiving tsukyu instruction for gengo shogai
identifiedPrevalence.note: Of the 166,403 children in public primary schools receiving tsukyu ni yoru shido in 2023, those in the gengo shogai category; MEXT, Reiwa 5 nendo Tsukyu ni yoru shido jisshi jokyo chosa. Almost all of Japan's identified figure sits in primary school: the same collection records 1,145 in public lower secondary and 23 in public upper secondary.

identifiedPrevalence.counted: pupils in so cluster 2 with a taalontwikkelingsstoornis (tos)
identifiedPrevalence.note: Pupils in special primary education (speciaal onderwijs) cluster 2 registered with a taalontwikkelingsstoornis (developmental language disorder), of 6,142 pupils in so cluster 2 in 2025; OCW in cijfers, Speciaal en voortgezet speciaal onderwijs, from DUO pupil files. Cluster 2 also serves deaf and hard-of-hearing pupils, so this is the language-disorder share of a wider cluster, and it counts only pupils placed in cluster 2 schools.

identifiedPrevalence.counted: vso cluster 2 pupils registered with a taalontwikkelingsstoornis (tos)
identifiedPrevalence.note: Share of secondary special education (vso) cluster 2 pupils registered with a taalontwikkelingsstoornis in 2025; OCW in cijfers, from DUO pupil files. Language disorders were first registered in vso only in 2022, and OCW in cijfers says the vso figure is probably an under-registration and that the true number of vso pupils with tos is expected to be higher.

evidence.quote: namelijk 5.455 van de 6.142 leerlingen in so cluster 2 in 2025

identifiedPrevalence.note: Pupils recorded with troubles du langage et de la parole among pupils with a disability schooled in milieu ordinaire, 2006; MENESR-DEPP, Note d'Information 36, December 2016, figure 2. identifiedPrevalence.counted: pupils with some form of ALN or SEN for whom 'Speech, language and communication difficulties' was reported as a type of need
identifiedPrevalence.denominator: pupils with some form of ALN or SEN
identifiedPrevalence.note: The most common type of need reported in the January 2024 schools' census in Wales, of 75,225 reports of ALN or SEN type. Schools may report as many needs for a pupil as required and the reports are not ranked, so a pupil is counted once under each type reported and the number of reports exceeds the number of pupils. An identification count made by schools, not an epidemiological estimate.

identifiedPrevalence.counted: pupils with some form of ALN or SEN for whom 'Speech, language and communication difficulties' was reported as a type of need
identifiedPrevalence.denominator: pupils with some form of ALN or SEN
identifiedPrevalence.note: The most common type of need reported in the January 2025 schools' census in Wales, of 66,471 reports of ALN or SEN type, an average of 1.5 per pupil with ALN or SEN. Schools may report as many needs for a pupil as required and the reports are not ranked, so a pupil is counted once under each type reported. An identification count made by schools, not an epidemiological estimate.

identifiedPrevalence.note: Students with language and speech disorders enrolled in 2019/20 in the Ministry of Education's Pronunciation and Speech Programme, which was implemented in 2004/05; UNESCO GEM Report PEER country profile for Oman, inclusion. identifiedPrevalence.counted: diagnoses of trastorno especifico del lenguaje (TEL) among all diagnoses made in the Programa de Integracion Escolar
identifiedPrevalence.denominator: diagnoses made in the Programa de Integracion Escolar
identifiedPrevalence.note: TEL was the third most frequent diagnosis in Chile's Programa de Integracion Escolar, at 17.9% of all diagnoses made in 2012, as reported in a peer-reviewed study of enrolment in escuelas de lenguaje (Revista Electronica Educare, 2023). This is a share of diagnoses recorded by the school integration programme, not a share of children and not an epidemiological estimate.

evidence.quote: el tercer diagnóstico más recurrente en el PIE corresponde al TEL con un 17,9% del total de diagnósticos realizados el año 2012

sources.label: Trastorno especifico del lenguaje y retraso de lenguaje: un estudio sobre matriculas en escuelas de lenguaje en Chile, Revista Electronica Educare (2023)
